overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Short Sk Hynix Daily ETF (SKHQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide inverse 2x (-200%) exposure to the daily price movement of the ADR of SK hynix, Inc. (NASDAQ: SKHY) stock, less fees and expenses SKHQ was launched on Sep 2, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
